title: Let's slow down
subtitle: A moment to land before you go.

steps.body:
Something intense came up. That makes sense — you were paying attention.

You don't have to resolve it. You just have to land.

Breathe in for four counts. Hold for four. Out for four.

Do this a few times, or just let the time pass.

steps.title: What's in the room with you right now?
steps.body: Name three things you can see. Let the room be real.
If you're in a hard place right now, support is available. You can reach it from the Support tab anytime.

exit.body:
Good. You can stay here as long as you need.

When you're ready, you can head back to what you were doing — it's still there, at your pace — or stop for now. There's no rush.
